files.justification: GATE 4 default: single shared responsibility is validating workflow YAML files for structural correctness; lint_workflow orchestrates all _check_* helpers and _lint_fragment in one tightly integrated validation pipeline, no independent cluster.

GATE 4 default: single shared responsibility is compiling a WorkflowDefinition into an executable manifest; all helpers (_build_dependency_graph, _compute_parallel_groups, _resolve_stage, _build_cli_command, resolve_params) are called from compile_workflow/validate_dag_contracts in one coherent pipeline, no independent cluster.

GATE 4 default: single shared responsibility is workflow CLI subcommand dispatch with shared parameter resolution, manifest loading, and workspace management; _cmd_run/_cmd_init_workspace/etc. all depend on the same _parse_params/_build_resolved_params/_resolve_base_dir/_confirm_execution/_load_manifest helpers, no independent cluster.
